svg.title: The 15 crates and their dependencies
svg.desc: An arrow leads from a crate to the one that uses it. Dependencies only point down, from L0 to L3: html-conform builds on six parsers and engines, a11y-rules on a11y-dom, a11y-report and stylesheet-parse, and a11y-wasm bundles a11y-rules and accname for the browser. a11y-perception and web-checks stand alone.
